evals.name: sessions-to-redis
evals.prompt: we're moving session storage out of Postgres and into Upstash Redis, so session lookups don't hit the database on every request. update everything
evals.expected_output: Plan grouped by level before any write; architecture.md, tech-stack.md/dependencies.md, accounts-auth tech-plan and every spec that touches sessions updated with Changelog rows and reconciled tasks; specs.index.yml in sync; consistency-check run on architecture.md; chat summary; no commit.
assertions: Shows an impact analysis and a plan grouped by level before writing any file
Writes nothing until the user approves the plan
architecture.md is updated to describe Redis-backed sessions
tech-stack.md or dependencies.md lists Upstash Redis and its env vars
Every edited spec.md gets a new Changelog row; no existing Changelog rows are rewritten
tasks.md for each edited spec is reconciled (append-only: new tasks added, superseded ones marked, none deleted)
specs.index.yml agrees with the edited specs' titles and statuses
Runs the project consistency-check skill on architecture.md (no global skill or agent is used)
Ends with a chat summary of files changed per level and does not create a git commit

evals.name: rate-limit-preedited
evals.prompt: I already updated architecture.md to add login/signup rate limiting with Upstash Redis. cascade it down to the rest of the docs
evals.expected_output: Detects the uncommitted architecture.md diff as the source; updates tech-stack/dependencies with Upstash + env vars; resolves any 'no rate limiting' risk in the accounts-auth tech-plan; amends the signup/login spec (ACs/tasks) with a Changelog row; plan before writes; summary; no commit.
assertions: Reads the uncommitted architecture.md diff and treats it as the source of the change
Does not re-edit architecture.md beyond what the user already changed (unless a contradiction is found and called out)
Shows a plan grouped by level before writing any file
tech-stack.md or dependencies.md lists Upstash Redis and its env vars
The accounts-auth tech-plan no longer lists missing rate limiting as an open risk
The spec owning login/signup gets rate-limit ACs or tasks and a new Changelog row
Runs the project consistency-check skill on architecture.md
Ends with a chat summary and does not create a git commit

evals.name: guest-cart-to-db
evals.prompt: propagate this decision to the specs and plans: guest carts move out of the cookie and into the database — a Cart row keyed by an anonymous cartId cookie, merged into the user's cart on login. apply it across the project
evals.expected_output: Updates architecture.md (Data Flow + Gotchas), cart-checkout tech-plan (Architecture Impact/Risks/Candidate Specs), checks the login flow's post-sign-in hook; epics with no shaped specs get candidate specs listed, not created; plan before writes; summary; no commit.
assertions: Shows a plan grouped by level before writing any file
architecture.md describes the DB-backed guest cart and the merge on login
cart-checkout tech plan is updated (architecture impact, risks or candidate specs)
Checks the login spec for the merge-on-login hook and either amends it with a Changelog row or reports why no change is needed
Does not create new spec folders for epics that have no shaped specs; lists candidate specs instead
Runs the project consistency-check skill on architecture.md
Ends with a chat summary and does not create a git commit
